stage2_results.local_context:
### The human backup plan

Through Muse, trained human contract workers made some calls and completed the exchanges with users. The idea was practical: when AI struggled, a person could help. Keeping a human in reserve seemed safer than leaving everything to AI.

But that backup plan changed the meaning of the call.
stage2_results.rewrite_hint: 引用: “Through Muse, trained human contract workers made some calls and completed the exchanges with users.” MUSE-HC-006に合わせ、テストでMuse経由の一部の電話を人間の契約スタッフが担当し、電話の相手とのやり取りを完了した、と範囲を限定してください。「users」がMuse利用者を指すように読める表現は避けてください。

stage2_results.local_context:
### The hidden cost of a smooth call

The test began without properly telling people what was happening. So people who thought they were speaking with AI were actually speaking with human staff. These workers did more than make the conversation smooth: the user’s sensitive information might be shared with contract workers at a call center. One helper meant one more person handling private data.

This is the interesting, slightly frightening turn. People often worry that an AI phone call will produce a strange answer. Here, the opposite happened. The voice was not simply human-like; a human was really speaking. And people were not properly told.
stage2_results.rewrite_hint: 引用: “So people who thought they were speaking with AI were actually speaking with human staff.” MUSE-HC-012が確認しているのは、適切な開示なしに契約スタッフが電話を担当するテストを開始したことです。相手がAIと話していると思っていたという認識や、その相手が実際に人間と話したという対応関係は断定せず、Metaの説明した開示上の問題に絞ってください。

stage2_results.local_context:
### The hidden cost of a smooth call

The test began without properly telling people what was happening. So people who thought they were speaking with AI were actually speaking with human staff. These workers did more than make the conversation smooth: In the test where contract workers handled calls, Meta employees raised concerns that sensitive information might be unintentionally shared with call-center contract workers when user information was needed to complete a call.

This is the interesting, slightly frightening turn. People often worry that an AI phone call will produce a strange answer. Here, the opposite happened. The voice was not simply human-like; a human was really speaking. And people were not properly told.
stage2_results.rewrite_hint: 引用: “So people who thought they were speaking with AI were actually speaking with human staff.” 修正: Metaのテストで適切な開示がなかったことに範囲を限定し、相手が実際にAIと話していると思っていたとの断定は避ける。参照Ledger fact_id: MUSE-HC-012
